description: The alert definition created with a data sink. It is an ordinary alert definition in the data sink namespace. Attach notification sinks manually and edit messages or cooldowns through the existing alert configuration; the system never overwrites these edits.

alertDefinition.description: The name of the shared alert definition raised when a run keeps failing or the data sink goes to Error. It defaults to Warning with a one-hour cooldown; both failure states share its notification settings.
alertDefinition.title: alertDefinition

sink.description: The name of an automatically provisioned notification sink. Empty in this version: notification sinks are attached manually to the alert definition.
sink.title: sink

status.description: The notification setup at creation, not a live report of manually edited alert definition. This version always starts as NeedsRecipient: attach notification sinks to the alert definition to be notified. Configured denotes automatically provisioned notification sinks.
status.title: status

title: DataSinkNotifications
